summary: P0 is ready for approval from the proof-security perspective. Model text cannot create facts or terminal authority at a live acceptance point; proof/counterproof, coverage/quantifier, and certificate-replay requirements fail closed; fact-first and TerminalAuthority are hard-wired to shadow mode; and the compatibility branch preserves stable product dispositions while recording the shadow decision for later audit. No P0 claim asserts that P2 proof-kernel soundness is proven.

non_blocking_findings.title: The evidence index needs an immutable approval binding
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The reviewed manifest did not hash-bind acceptance/evidence-index.json or acceptance/p0-fast-regression-repair.json; the validator schema-checks and cross-checks the evidence index but did not immutably bind its post-approval bytes.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Bind the final evidence-index hash and regression-repair summary through a non-circular approval/tag mechanism.

non_blocking_findings.title: Shadow TerminalAuthority delta is not fully projected into terminal policy input
non_blocking_findings.evidence: runner.py records proof_kernel_shadow_terminal_authority_decision on the issue, while the frozen terminal_policy_input projection records only the active terminal_authority_decision.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: During P2, include the shadow decision and proof-kernel mode in replayable trace projections.

non_blocking_findings.title: The future proof-kernel mode flip is not yet bound to P2 gate records
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The current source constant is shadow and has no user switch, but no CI rule yet requires P2 completion before a future authoritative value is accepted.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Add a source-to-evidence cutover assertion when P2 implementation begins.

non_blocking_findings.title: Black and remote CI remain unverified
non_blocking_findings.evidence: The evidence index records the local Black hang and that the workflow has not run remotely because no push was authorized.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Confirm these hygiene gates on an authorized remote path; they are not proof-soundness defects.

non_blocking_findings.title: Protocol status-label change needs frozen replay confirmation
non_blocking_findings.evidence: abffcc65 changes validator_fact_resolution.status from no_new_parameterized_request to exhausted; no product consumer of the former label was found.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Include the label in the P1 frozen-replay equivalence audit.

checks.name: reviewed_commit_and_tree_identity
checks.evidence: Commit b74e6b6e82224d487392ad7e03d794d6592a514a resolves to tree aca131c453e2176944527a1bd3902c08d1bc3948; the only untracked paths during review were local harness inputs under .review/.

checks.name: model_text_cannot_create_facts
checks.evidence: V3 claims are recomputed over frozen tool payloads; facts require verified certificates, coverage, producer, code-hash, location, and capability checks before admission.

checks.name: model_text_cannot_create_terminal_authority
checks.evidence: TerminalAuthority grants confirmation only from complete programmatic proof or verified closure plus promotion; all other states resolve conservatively.

checks.name: proof_counterproof_requirements_fail_closed
checks.evidence: Incomplete, model-produced, mismatched, or conflicting proof objects cannot promote and fall back to needs_review/unknown.

checks.name: coverage_quantifier_requirements_fail_closed
checks.evidence: Universal/refutation claims require complete structured coverage; existence claims require located witnesses and dependency hashes; missing coverage remains unknown.

checks.name: certificate_replay_requirements_fail_closed
checks.evidence: Malformed schema/hash bindings are rejected, strict V2/V3 queues require replayable certificates, and uncertified observations cannot enter the decision delta.

checks.name: fact_first_stays_shadow_only
checks.evidence: The internal mode constant is shadow with no user configuration; preview runs on a copy and does not mutate the V1 decision slice.

checks.name: terminal_authority_stays_shadow_and_preserves_stable_dispositions
checks.evidence: The shadow evaluator result is recorded separately while validation_pipeline_compat preserves a stable confirmed disposition; abffcc65 restores bounded V0 completion.

checks.name: no_promotion_weakening_or_range_exception
checks.evidence: Promotion tiers are unchanged, the remaining four-TP delta is not used to alter policy, and no authority/promotion path branches on Range truth or fixture identity.

checks.name: phase_stop_conditions_prevent_unsound_cutover
checks.evidence: P0-P7 define explicit stop/rollback conditions and the evidence validator rejects premature phase entry or false approval state.

checks.name: no_p0_claim_that_p2_soundness_is_proven
checks.evidence: P2 remains pending and the P0 evidence explicitly disclaims proof-kernel qualification and release eligibility.

checks.name: p0_design_evidence_gate_fails_closed
checks.evidence: The local validator passed on the reviewed tree while reporting absent external aggregates as explicit limitations; strict mode rejects those missing artifacts.

limitations: The review was read-only; pytest was not rerun by this reviewer, and recorded test results were checked through the evidence index and direct source/test inspection.
Ignored benchmark aggregates were absent and remain hash-bound external limitations rather than locally replayed evidence.
Range ground-truth content and case identities were not read.
P2 proof-kernel qualification is intentionally out of scope and remains gated by generic fixtures, safe-corpus tests, certificate replay, and proof-security review.
Remote CI could not be confirmed because no push was authorized.
attestation: I approve the P0 design for the proof_security role at maximum reasoning depth using deepseek-v4-pro through dsh/0.1.0-rc.6. The reviewed objects are commit b74e6b6e82224d487392ad7e03d794d6592a514a and tree aca131c453e2176944527a1bd3902c08d1bc3948. The review was read-only, did not read Range truth content, did not run an external-model benchmark, and does not assert P2 proof-kernel soundness or authorize runtime cutover.
